job.description:
Provide safe, nurturing and individualised care to children and young people with learning disabilities and/or autism. Support their wellbeing, rights, development and independence through consistent, child-centred practice as part of the residential care team.

  • Recognise and challenge unsafe or poor practice, take immediate steps to protect children where necessary and report concerns promptly.
  • Support children with meals, appointments, education, leisure, family contact and meaningful activities.
  • Participate in shift handovers, team meetings, induction and reflective discussions; seek guidance when uncertain.
  • Take responsibility for completing allocated duties, communicating delays and escalating matters beyond your competence or authority.

This is not simply about managing the systems we have today. It's about determining the systems we need for tomorrow.

You will take ownership of a complex ecosystem of business applications, SaaS platforms, bespoke software and data capabilities, ensuring they work seamlessly together to support a high-volume, nationwide, next-day parcel delivery operation.

· Unlock the value of data: Lead data strategy, governance and business intelligence to enable better, insight-driven decisions.
· Lead people and investment: Inspire and develop a team of 23, manage budgets and strategic vendor relationships, and ensure technology investment delivers measurable business value.
What you'll bring
You'll be an established senior IT or business systems leader with the strategic vision, technical expertise and commercial judgement to lead a complex technology environment through its next stage of evolution.

· Significant experience leading business systems, enterprise applications or a similarly complex technology function.
· Proven ownership of end-to-end systems integration and large-scale technology transformation.
· The ability to develop a strategic roadmap that translates business ambitions into scalable, sustainable technology solutions.
· Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, ideally of comparable scale.
· Strong expertise in managing third-party platforms, systems integrators, vendors and technology investment.
· A sound understanding of data strategy, business intelligence, systems architecture and operational resilience.
· The credibility to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical decisions into commercial outcomes.
Experience in transport, logistics, parcel delivery or supply chain operations would be a significant advantage. Familiarity with ERP, CRM, TMS, WMS, API-led integration and cloud platforms would also be valuable.

This is an opportunity to make a genuine strategic impact in a business where technology directly enables growth, operational performance and customer experience.
You'll have the influence to shape our future systems architecture, the challenge of integrating and scaling technology across a nationwide network, and the opportunity to lead a team of 23 through meaningful transformation.
We're looking for someone who sees beyond today's operational demands and knows what needs to be built now to enable the business to succeed tomorrow.

· Proven experience within transport and logistics.

· Exceptional customer service and communication skills.
· Experience dealing directly with customers and key stakeholders.
· Strong commercial awareness and a results-driven approach.
· The confidence to influence, challenge and negotiate when required.
· Excellent problem-solving skills.
· The ability to stay calm and positive when the pressure is on.
· A proactive approach - you see something that needs doing and you do it.
And your personality?
This is where you can really make your mark.
We’re looking for someone who is:
Ambitious. You want to progress, develop and build a career.
Dynamic. You bring energy, enthusiasm and ideas.
Resilient. When things go wrong, you focus on fixing them.
Proactive. You don’t wait for problems to land on your desk.
Goal-oriented. You’re motivated by achievement and getting results.
Flexible. You can adapt quickly when priorities change.
Customer-focused. You genuinely care about the experience you deliver.
Positive. You see challenges as opportunities rather than obstacles.
What's in it for you?
This is a role for someone who wants more.
More responsibility.
More exposure.
More opportunity to influence.
More opportunity to develop.
You’ll have the opportunity to manage a high-profile client relationship, broaden your commercial and leadership experience and develop skills that can take your career well beyond traditional transport operations.
There are real opportunities for career progression and growth for someone who demonstrates the drive, capability and ambition to succeed.

job.description:
Passionate about food, excited by FMCG and ready to make a real impact on quality, safety and innovation?
We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented food technical professional to join a dynamic business bringing the flavours of Italy to the UK through our Diforti range.

If you love food, thrive on variety and have the technical expertise and Italian language skills to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: PA To Managing Director
job.description:
PA to Managing Director / Office Manager
30 hours per week (approx.) - Monday to Friday
We are looking for a proactive, highly organised and commercially minded PA / Office Manager to support the Managing Director within a busy, family-run business.
The core business is potato packing and distribution, with wider interests in commercial property and farming. This makes the role extremely varied and suited to someone who enjoys getting involved across different areas of a business rather than working within a narrowly defined remit.
The role is primarily focused on supporting the Managing Director, with additional support to the Operations Director and, where required, the wider family on both business and personal matters.
The Role
Key responsibilities will include:
· Acting as PA to the Managing Director, including drafting emails, letters and other correspondence on his behalf.
· Working closely with the Managing Director on correspondence and business matters, sometimes preparing information independently and sometimes working through matters together.
· Providing occasional personal and family PA support, including appointments, travel, purchases, insurance and other ad hoc matters.
· Acting as an effective gatekeeper - understanding what callers or visitors need, dealing with matters where appropriate and identifying what genuinely requires the Managing Director’s attention.
· Answering incoming calls, taking customer orders and dealing with customers visiting reception for orders and collections.
· Managing the general day-to-day office administration and keeping records, paperwork and office filing systems organised.
· Supporting day-to-day staff administration, including holidays, employee queries, confidential records and general HR paperwork.
· Purchasing, supplier liaison, insurance, utilities and other general business administration.
· Looking for potential cost-saving opportunities across the business, researching alternatives and presenting recommendations where appropriate.
· Researching issues, suppliers and possible solutions rather than simply highlighting problems.
· Supporting the administration of the company’s commercial property portfolio, including vacant properties, utilities, planning matters, councils, legislation and liaison with professional advisers where required.
· Supporting matters relating to the farm, land and wider business interests.
· Coordinating Health & Safety administration, including reviewing actions arising from external H&S audits, completing routine checks and ensuring required actions are followed up.
· Assisting with vehicle, FLT and maintenance administration, including monitoring relevant renewal and compliance dates alongside the Managing Director.
· Providing occasional payroll/timesheet cover when required, with appropriate training and support.
· Taking ownership of tasks and ensuring matters are followed through to completion.
The Person
Personality and attitude are particularly important.
We are looking for somebody who is:
· Proactive, resourceful and able to use their own initiative.
· Highly organised and able to manage several very different matters at once.
· Confident and capable of dealing with customers, suppliers, employees, councils and professional advisers.
· Commercially aware and naturally inclined to research solutions and identify opportunities for improvement.
· Able to take ownership of a matter and progress it without needing a detailed list of instructions.
· A strong gatekeeper with good judgement about what genuinely requires the Managing Director’s involvement.
· A strong written communicator, comfortable drafting correspondence on somebody else’s behalf.
· Trustworthy, discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
· Down-to-earth, practical and happy working within a close-knit family business.
· Willing to get involved and help wherever reasonably needed rather than being constrained by a rigid job description.
The successful candidate needs to be comfortable taking initiative while also working closely with a Managing Director who remains actively involved in the business and retains final sign-off on decisions.
Working Environment
This is a traditional, hands-on and fully office-based environment. The role is 30 hours per week across five days, so regular day-to-day presence within the business is important.
As with many busy family businesses, there will be occasions when the role goes beyond a conventional PA or Office Manager job description. We are looking for someone with a ‘pitch in’ attitude who will naturally find productive things to do during quieter periods and is happy to help keep the office organised and running smoothly.
An interest in property or farming would be advantageous but is not essential. More important is somebody who is interested and capable enough to get to grips with unfamiliar subjects, carry out research, speak confidently to the relevant people and clearly summarise the position for the Managing Director.
Specific Health & Safety, payroll, property or agricultural qualifications are not required.
